content.text:
Resubmitted with the verifier's fix applied.

- **Period now renders with the numeral**: § 19.2 reads "For ninety (90) days after delivery…", curing the deterministic period check.
- **Minimality kept**: the first attempt with "and any software delivered to Customer" failed the 1.5x word ratio once "(90)" was added, so I tightened the insertion to "and software delivered to Customer" (19 words vs. 13 removed) — validated `ok:true` with no minimality errors.
- **Everything else unchanged**: the retained sentence "after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation", § 19.4's cross-reference to "Section 19.1 or 19.2", and all other § 19 language are untouched; element coverage remains three already-met elements (§ 19.1 Services warranty; § 19.4 repair/replace; § 19.4 refund) plus the software-conformance element addressed by operation 1, at fallback level.
